# Hash Tables: A Complete Overview

Hash tables are one of the most versatile and widely used data structures in computing, enabling **average constant-time O(1) lookup, insertion, and deletion**. This remarkable efficiency comes from a clever design that trades space for speed, making hash tables fundamental to databases, caches, programming language implementations (dictionaries, objects, hash maps, hash sets, hash collections), and many other applications.
